'''VAB-927''' was the number assigned to a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] prisoner held on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. The [[Alien/Legends|alien]] was transferred from [[Detention Block AA-23/Legends|Detention Block AA-23]] to [[Docking Bay 28-C]] while the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] was under [[Code-Red]] security status. This was due to an explosion in the engineering plant that was suspected of being the first move in an attempt to rescue VAB-927.
